tips.text: Bring Nekros with a Slash weapon; Desecrate gives dead Ghouls an extra loot roll.
Farm Tonkkatt in the same run; its parts drop from the other Ghouls here.
Check your kills closely; Ghouls hide in a normal Grineer crowd and are easy to miss.
Level a loadout first on a brand-new account; Olympus enemies can overwhelm early gear.
Expect about half an hour for a full set of Tak & Lug and Tonkkatt.
Players call this an easy farm and the weapon fun and new-player friendly.
